description: An accessible page can be used in different ways. Some people use a keyboard, a screen reader or larger text. Learn small choices that make words, forms and controls easier for more people to use. Try runnable HTML here with a keyboard as well as a mouse. A screen reader is a tool that reads page information aloud. Test real pages with people and tools; one automated check cannot prove everything works.
versionNote: Uses semantic HTML and WCAG 2.2 beginner principles; examples are not a compliance certificate.
